newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize and soybeans slip on USDA.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize and soybeans slip on USDA.

text.p: Argentine cash maize and soybean prices slipped at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange by midsession, shadowing U.S. prices after USDA's bearish November crop and supply/demand reports, traders said.

Cash maize turnover was brisk. May soybean volume was also hearty, with prices also under pressure from perceptions that sowing is progressing well. Spot soybean volume was middling. March sunflower seed was stable in medium volume, with good demand by crushers. January wheat slipped in slow trade. Prices were dragged along a bit by lower maize and soybeans, but were also sagging due to slowish FOB sales and plentiful supply.
